data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'rahana' which means 'to be content'. A name for a noble and content woman. Parents who choose Rehana usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, content and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is also associated with the qualities of kindness, gentleness, and compassion. In modern usage, the name Rehana is often used to signify beauty, charm, and allure. It is a popular name among Muslims worldwide and is considered a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl.
